title: Aureline M5 supported-line ORR history
description: Canonical per-domain ORR-history record for the ORR-history-event object. Names the recorded ORR / go-no-go decision event, its supported line association, the preserved go/no-go outcome, the retained support-window decision, whether the history event has been archived, and its export class so supported-line ORR and support-window decisions are never lost to memory and stay joined to exact build/release-line identity. Downstream release, help, support, program-governance, and executive-steering surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's ORR history by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
